name: Emhet
description: Before departing, Emhet offers the party one final chance to request assistance. He tells Dana she may continue to seek his guidance through prayer if she needs it. He reminds the party that they now hold the keys, and warns that if "the mind walks," they should hold their breath, avoid shouting, and trust the path—closing with the words: "If the mind walks, hold your breath. Do not yell. Trust the path, gatekeeper."
